scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build:apk: npm run build -w client && cd client && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:apk:debug: npm run build -w client && cd client && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
